shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch
sed -n '1,260p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts
sed -n '1,260p' src/types/ai.ts
sed -n '1,220p' .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
cat package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.*#[0-9]+|spec:\" src/**/*.test.ts | head -80
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts
rg -n 'ajv' package-lock.json node_modules/ajv/package.json 2>/dev/null | head
ls scripts/spec-links 2>/dev/null || true
rg -n 'test\\(' src/orchestration/tools/*.test.ts 2>/dev/null | head"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"specs/.+#[0-9]+|@spec|specAnchor|SPEC\" src --glob '*.test.ts' | head -100
find specs -name spec.md -maxdepth 3 -print | head
node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\""

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs
rg -n \"validated by\" specs | head -30
sed -n '1,120p' src/orchestration/tools/toolChoice.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,260p' scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs
sed -n '1,260p' scripts/check-spec-links.mjs
rg -n \"#([0-9]+).*test|spec.*ordinal|anchor\" scripts .lore | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '1,40p'
git diff --check
git diff -- src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short
git diff --check
git add .lore/dod.md package.json package-lock.json specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
git commit -m "Validate tool input before execution"
git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
if ! git diff --quiet @{upstream}..HEAD; then git push origin HEAD; fi
git status --short --branch
git rev-list --left-right --count @{upstream}...HEAD'
